{{Quote|Help! Phantoms! Do something, R2! I'm incapable of ordering my thoughts!|C-3PO to R2-D2|<ref name="TC">{{StoryCite|story=The Cloud|book=MyComyc|bformatted=''MyComyc'' 7}}</ref>}}
'''Phantoms''' were mysterious, unsubstantial entities that could become manifest as nebulous images with a vague [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] shape. While traveling through [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] with his partner [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] witnessed two such apparitions when their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] entered a strange cloud. The droid got frightened, and the phantoms faded from sight just as quickly as they had appeared.<ref name="TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phantoms appeared in ''[[The Cloud]]'',<ref name="TC" /> a [[Wikipedia:Spain|Spanish]] story of undetermined [[canon]]icity that was published in [[1986]] under the ''[[MyComyc]]'' label.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/droids-and-ewoks-return-spains-lost-star-wars-comic-strips|text=Droids and Ewoks Return: Spain's Lost ''Star Wars'' Comic Strips|int=Droids and Ewoks Return: Spain's Lost Star Wars Comic Strips|nolive=1}}</ref> The ''Star Wars'' author [[Abel G. Peña]], who translated the story in [[Wikipedia:English language|English]] for the first time in [[2013]], chose to render the original Spanish term ''fantasmas'' not as the more common equivalent "[[Wikipedia:Ghost|ghosts]]" but the more literal "phantoms," paying homage to the title of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Hasslein">{{Blogspot|subdomain=hassleinbooks|url=2013/03/guest-blog-ee-chee-wa-maa-translating.html|name=Hasslein Blog|text=Ee Chee Wa Maa! Translating Spain's Long-Lost Ewoks and Droids Comics}}</ref>

In the [[1997]] novel ''[[Galaxy of Fear: Ghost of the Jedi]]'', it was stated that [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]] may not always have a clearly defined appearance. Before assuming a [[Human/Legends|Human]] likeness, the ghost of [[Aidan Bok]] manifested itself as a floating, shapeless figure made of greyish energy.<ref name="GOF">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Ghost of the Jedi]]''</ref> The phantoms shown in ''The Cloud'' share similarities<ref name="TC" /> with the shapeless Force ghosts described in ''Ghost of the Jedi''.<ref name="GOF" />
